risk_report.stage: Gather Requirements
risk_report.risk: Inadequate requirements gathering may lead to misunderstandings of stakeholder needs.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct thorough stakeholder interviews and reviews to validate requirements.

risk_report.stage: Create System Design
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent system design may result in integration issues and scalability problems.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a unified design framework and conduct regular design reviews.

risk_report.stage: Design Database Schema
risk_report.risk: Poor database schema design may cause data inconsistencies and performance issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established database modeling techniques and solicit feedback from experienced database administrators.

risk_report.stage: Develop QR-Code Scanning Feature
risk_report.risk: QR-code scanning feature may be vulnerable to security exploits or compatibility issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement secure coding practices and conduct thorough testing on various devices and platforms.

risk_report.stage: Develop Manual Attendance Entry Feature
risk_report.risk: Manual attendance entry feature may be prone to human error, leading to inaccurate attendance records.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement data validation and verification mechanisms to minimize errors.

risk_report.stage: Develop Attendance Reporting Feature
risk_report.risk: Attendance reporting feature may not meet the requirements of various stakeholders, leading to dissatisfaction.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage with stakeholders to understand their reporting needs and provide customizable reporting options.

risk_report.stage: Develop Student Web Portal
risk_report.risk: Student web portal may be vulnerable to security threats, compromising sensitive student information.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement robust security measures, such as encryption and secure authentication protocols.

risk_report.stage: Develop Parent SMS Alert Feature
risk_report.risk: Parent SMS alert feature may be affected by unreliable or expensive SMS gateway services.
risk_report.mitigation: Research and select a reliable SMS gateway service provider with a robust infrastructure.

risk_report.stage: Develop Attendance Policy Configuration Feature
risk_report.risk: Attendance policy configuration feature may be too complex, leading to misconfiguration by administrators.
risk_report.mitigation: Provide intuitive configuration interfaces and clear documentation to facilitate correct setup.

risk_report.stage: Develop Excused Absence Request Feature
risk_report.risk: Excused absence request feature may be abused by students, leading to unnecessary absences.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement a robust approval process and monitoring system to detect potential abuse.

risk_report.stage: Implement Data Synchronization
risk_report.risk: Data synchronization may cause data inconsistencies or losses due to incorrect implementation.
risk_report.mitigation: Use established data synchronization protocols and conduct thorough testing to ensure data integrity.

risk_report.stage: Implement Load Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate load testing may lead to system crashes or performance issues under heavy loads.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct comprehensive load testing using realistic scenarios and identify performance bottlenecks.

risk_report.stage: Conduct Unit Testing
risk_report.risk: Inadequate unit testing may result in undetected bugs or defects in individual components.
risk_report.mitigation: Write comprehensive unit tests and use automated testing frameworks to ensure thorough coverage.

risk_report.stage: Conduct Integration Testing
risk_report.risk: Integration testing may reveal unforeseen issues between components, causing project delays.
risk_report.mitigation: Use continuous integration techniques and conduct regular integration testing to identify issues early.

risk_report.stage: Conduct System Testing
risk_report.risk: System testing may not cover all possible scenarios, leading to undiscovered defects or issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a comprehensive testing strategy, including end-to-end testing and user acceptance testing.

risk_report.stage: Deploy System to Staging Environment
risk_report.risk: Deployment to staging environment may introduce configuration errors or inconsistencies.
risk_report.mitigation: Use automated deployment scripts and conduct thorough verification after deployment.

risk_report.stage: Conduct User Acceptance Testing
risk_report.risk: User acceptance testing may reveal significant issues or defects, requiring costly rework.
risk_report.mitigation: Engage stakeholders early in the development process and conduct regular feedback sessions to ensure alignment with expectations.

risk_report.stage: Deploy System to Production Environment
risk_report.risk: Deployment to production environment may cause downtime or disruptions to existing systems.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop a detailed deployment plan, including rollback procedures, and conduct deployment during maintenance windows.

risk_report.stage: Monitor System Performance
risk_report.risk: Inadequate monitoring may lead to undetected performance issues or security breaches.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement comprehensive monitoring tools and establish a proactive incident response plan.

risk_report.stage: Integrate with Student Information System
risk_report.risk: Integration with student information system may be complicated by incompatible data formats or APIs.
risk_report.mitigation: Collaborate with student information system vendors to ensure compatibility and develop a robust integration strategy.

requirements: Teachers can mark student attendance via a biometric fingerprint scan at the start of each class, with the system automatically recording the timestamp and classroom location.
Students can submit a real-time absence request through the mobile app, which must be approved by the teacher before being marked as excused in the system.
Parents receive an automated WhatsApp message within 2 minutes of their child being marked absent, including the reason (if provided) and a link to submit an excuse.
The system enforces a 15-minute grace period for late arrivals, after which students are marked as late and teachers receive a push notification to verify the tardiness.
Admin staff can generate a weekly attendance summary report filtered by class, teacher, or student, with export options to PDF and Excel for parent-teacher meetings.
The system integrates with the school’s timetable API to automatically populate the expected attendance list for each class period, reducing manual entry errors.
Teachers can override attendance marks for students with documented medical exemptions, with the override reason logged in an audit trail for compliance.
The system sends a daily SMS to parents of students with 3 or more consecutive absences, including a link to view detailed attendance records and contact the homeroom teacher.
The attendance system must process biometric scans within 2 seconds to prevent classroom delays during high-traffic periods like morning assembly.
All attendance data must be backed up to a secondary server every 5 minutes to ensure no more than 5 minutes of data loss in case of primary server failure.
The mobile app must function offline and sync attendance data to the server once connectivity is restored, ensuring 100% data capture even in areas with poor network coverage.
The system must support simultaneous access by up to 500 teachers during peak hours (8:00 AM - 3:00 PM) without performance degradation, as measured by response times under 1 second.
Attendance records must be retained for a minimum of 5 years to comply with local education board regulations, with secure archival in encrypted storage.

risk_report.stage: Define system architecture and high-level design
risk_report.risk: Inadequate scalability planning may lead to system bottlenecks under peak load.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct architecture reviews with load testing experts to ensure horizontal scalability.

risk_report.stage: Design database schema for attendance records, biometric data, and audit trails
risk_report.risk: Poor schema design may cause slow query performance or data integrity issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Normalize critical tables while denormalizing for performance, and implement indexing strategies.

risk_report.stage: Design API specifications for timetable integration and mobile app communication
risk_report.risk: Inconsistent API contracts may lead to integration failures or versioning issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use OpenAPI/Swagger for formal specification and version control for backward compatibility.

risk_report.stage: Design user interfaces for teacher dashboard, mobile app, and admin reports
risk_report.risk: Poor UX design may result in low adoption or user errors in attendance recording.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct iterative usability testing with target users to refine workflows and layouts.

risk_report.stage: Set up development environment with version control and CI/CD pipeline
risk_report.risk: Inadequate CI/CD setup may delay deployments or introduce integration bugs.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement automated testing gates and environment parity checks in the pipeline.

risk_report.stage: Implement biometric fingerprint scan integration with 2-second response time
risk_report.risk: Hardware or SDK limitations may prevent meeting the 2-second response time requirement.
risk_report.mitigation: Benchmark SDKs early and plan fallback mechanisms (e.g., QR code) if performance is unmet.

risk_report.stage: Implement attendance recording with timestamp, location, and grace period logic
risk_report.risk: Incorrect grace period logic may lead to false absences or attendance fraud.
risk_report.mitigation: Validate grace period rules with stakeholders and implement automated reconciliation checks.

risk_report.stage: Implement real-time absence request submission and teacher approval workflow
risk_report.risk: Race conditions or notification delays may disrupt the approval process.
risk_report.mitigation: Use event sourcing or transactional outbox patterns to ensure consistency in workflows.

risk_report.stage: Implement automated WhatsApp and SMS notification system with templates
risk_report.risk: Template errors or carrier delays may result in missed notifications.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement template validation and retry mechanisms with fallback to alternative channels.

risk_report.stage: Implement weekly attendance summary report generation with export options
risk_report.risk: Report generation may time out or fail under heavy load.
risk_report.mitigation: Optimize queries with materialized views and implement asynchronous report generation.

risk_report.stage: Implement timetable API integration for expected attendance population
risk_report.risk: API rate limits or schema mismatches may cause incomplete or stale attendance data.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement caching, retry logic, and schema validation to handle API inconsistencies.

risk_report.stage: Implement teacher override functionality with audit trail logging
risk_report.risk: Unauthorized overrides may go undetected due to weak audit controls.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce role-based access and log all override actions with immutable storage.

risk_report.stage: Implement daily SMS alert for 3+ consecutive absences
risk_report.risk: False positives or delayed alerts may erode trust in the system.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement deduplication logic and validate absence patterns before sending alerts.

risk_report.stage: Implement data backup to secondary server every 5 minutes
risk_report.risk: Backup failures may lead to data loss during critical failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Monitor backup jobs in real-time and implement automated alerting for failures.

risk_report.stage: Implement offline-first mobile app with sync capability
risk_report.risk: Sync conflicts or data corruption may occur during offline operations.
risk_report.mitigation: Use conflict-free replicated data types (CRDTs) or operational transforms for sync.

risk_report.stage: Implement load testing and scalability measures for 500 concurrent users
risk_report.risk: Inadequate load testing may reveal scalability issues only in production.
risk_report.mitigation: Simulate realistic user journeys and monitor resource usage under load.

risk_report.stage: Implement data retention policy with encrypted archival for 5 years
risk_report.risk: Encryption key mismanagement may lead to data unavailability or compliance violations.
risk_report.mitigation: Use a key management system (KMS) with automatic key rotation and access auditing.

risk_report.stage: Unit test individual components (biometric, API, UI, notifications)
risk_report.risk: Incomplete unit test coverage may allow critical bugs to slip into integration testing.
risk_report.mitigation: Enforce 100% branch coverage for critical paths and use mutation testing.

risk_report.stage: Integration test end-to-end workflows (attendance, approvals, notifications)
risk_report.risk: Integration tests may not cover edge cases in real-world usage.
risk_report.mitigation: Involve domain experts to design test cases for atypical scenarios.

risk_report.stage: Performance and load testing under peak conditions
risk_report.risk: Performance bottlenecks may only surface under production-like conditions.
risk_report.mitigation: Use production-like data volumes and gradually increase load to identify breaking points.

risk_report.stage: Security testing (data encryption, audit trails, access control)
risk_report.risk: Undetected vulnerabilities may lead to data breaches or compliance failures.
risk_report.mitigation: Conduct third-party penetration testing and static/dynamic code analysis.

risk_report.stage: User acceptance testing (UAT) with pilot group of teachers and parents
risk_report.risk: Feedback from UAT may highlight critical usability issues late in the process.
risk_report.mitigation: Run parallel UAT cycles with iterative improvements before full rollout.

risk_report.stage: Prepare deployment artifacts (containers, scripts, documentation)
risk_report.risk: Incomplete or incorrect artifacts may cause deployment failures or downtime.
risk_report.mitigation: Automate artifact generation and validate them in a staging environment.

risk_report.stage: Deploy to staging environment for final validation
risk_report.risk: Staging may not fully replicate production, leading to undiscovered issues.
risk_report.mitigation: Use infrastructure-as-code to ensure staging mirrors production.

risk_report.stage: Deploy to production with rollback plan and monitoring setup
risk_report.risk: Deployment errors may cause prolonged downtime or data corruption.
risk_report.mitigation: Implement blue-green deployment and automated rollback triggers.

risk_report.stage: Conduct post-deployment review and address critical issues
risk_report.risk: Post-deployment issues may go unaddressed due to lack of prioritization.
risk_report.mitigation: Establish a dedicated incident response team for rapid issue resolution.

risk_report.stage: Provide training materials and conduct user training sessions
risk_report.risk: Inadequate training may lead to low user adoption or incorrect usage.
risk_report.mitigation: Develop interactive training modules and gather feedback for iterative improvements.
